description:
A free batch photo/image resizer tool

Fotosizer is a free batch photo/image resizer tool. It lets you resize hundreds of photos in a matter of minutes in a quick and easy way.
- Fixed duplication of columns in the image selection list in detail view.
- Fixed COMException error in Browse for folder dialog on Windows 7.
- Added French language translation corrections.
- Fixed issue with some EXIF metadata not being displayed in image selection list columns.
- Fixed resizing of animated gif images that was previously bloating file size.
- Fixed issue with some images not loading the EXIF orientation correctly resulting in wrongly rotated images after processing.
- Fixed setting of "Change DPI to" setting so that it cannot accept a zero value that was breaking resizing.
- Added Heic image format support.
- Added WebP image format built-in support without requirement for libwebp and C++ redistributable.
